entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I need to start a return for some cycling shoes I bought a few weeks ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could I get your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Mark Rivera, and the order number is VF-8675309.
Thank you, Mark. I have your order right here. Before we proceed, can I ask what the specific issue with the shoes is? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's a fit issue. I've worn them on a couple of rides, and they're just giving me terrible blisters on my heels. I tried adjusting the cleats and everything, but the fit is just wrong for my foot shape.
I'm sorry to hear that the cycling shoes are causing blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check our return policy for you. One moment.
Thanks. I'm just hoping to get a full refund.

Okay, Mark, I've got it. It looks like your order was delivered 25 days ago. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the window. I can go ahead and approve this return for you.

That's great news, I appreciate that. Now, here's a thought. I had to pay my local bike shop to install the cleats on these shoes. Since I have to return them, would it be possible to get a small discount code for a future purchase to offset that cost?

I understand your position, but unfortunately, our policy on a standard return only covers the refund for the product's purchase price. We aren't able to offer additional credits or discounts for third-party service costs.
I see. Can't make an exception? It's just a small gesture for the inconvenience.

I'm afraid my system is quite strict on that and won't allow me to generate a goodwill credit for this type of situation. The best I can do is process the full refund for the shoes as soon as we receive them back at our warehouse.
Alright, fair enough. It was worth asking. So, you'll email me a return label?

Yes, absolutely. I've just processed the return authorization. You should receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label and instructions within the next 15 minutes. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Sarah.
You're very welcome, Mark. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
